title: 9 Impulses a Godly Man Learns to Wait Ten Minutes On
caption:
A man without self-control is like a city with its walls broken down (Proverbs 25:28). Ten minutes is a wall.

Nine impulses to put a timer on. Start with one this week.

Which one hits you first?

#faith #selfcontrol #discipline #godlymen #christianman #proverbs
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
